selection_population: All eight originally scheduled rows per family. Retired and absent rows remain listed; figure group is incomplete until every scheduled row is terminal and independently audited or explicitly retired.
valid_representative: Lower median of valid_completed rows ordered by native actual geometric goal time, then seed, schedule sequence, run_id. No method preference.
failure_class: For each non-valid row: infrastructure if receipt/evidence integrity fails; else task phase + sorted false safety gate names. Retired rows are not observed failures.
failure_representative: Choose largest failure class; ties lexicographic class key. Lower median of that class ordered by failure-inclusive restricted goal time, then seed, schedule sequence, run_id.
missing_image_policy: Never replace a selected row because its images are absent or unattractive. Record selection and missing image coverage; render no scene evidence for that selection.
native_frame_rule: Use earliest and latest distinct retained native source frames for each selected row; if only one exists, render that one and mark sparse coverage. No generated or reconstructed Gazebo images.
format: 170 mm wide, native scene images + readable Chinese source captions; PDF/SVG and600dpiPNG. Preserve original PNG SHA, source stamp and byte-identical raw-image pixels in selection data.
scope: Six reused parent geometries only; illustrative actual records, no cross-scene generalization or independent-seed statistical claim.
